_rule: Codes are compared in the subject map's key form (upper case, letters and digits only), statewide; each college under a code is listed with its own held courses. A suggestion is the vote's winner with its votes and share; it missed the 98% self-recall floor, which is why the course is held, so it decides nothing. Near entries share the first three characters or extend the code. A TOP code is never read.
_what: The local subject codes the pile mint holds on (no route gives their courses a SUBJ4), ranked by the held courses a decided common subject code releases. Read-only; nothing here is a decision.
